_regionsNote: fra1 = Frankfurt — pins every function to the region Supabase lives in (eu-central-1) so each PostgREST call is intra-region (~1-3 ms) instead of trans-Atlantic (~90-110 ms from the iad1 default). If Supabase turns out to be somewhere else, swap for the matching Vercel region: arn1 eu-north-1, dub1 eu-west-1, sfo1 us-west-1, iad1 us-east-1, hnd1 ap-northeast-1.
